capabilities: open an inline find panel in the editor
switch to find and replace mode
match text case-sensitively, whole-word, or by regex
highlight matches in the current editor
bind hotkeys for find and find-and-replace commands
disambiguation: It only searches and replaces within the current editor; it does not search across the whole vault.
extras: Manual installation only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README also mentions it accesses internal Obsidian runtime objects for the CodeMirror view.
problem: Obsidian's default editor find lacks a dedicated inline panel with whole-word and regex options and global Esc handling.
summary: Inline editor search and replace panel with match case, whole word, and regex matching, plus match highlighting.
